ops.text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits of any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, provided that either Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.5 already applies New York law, but the Agreement has no forum clause. We added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, with a carve-out only for temporary injunctive relief, consistent with our preferred governing law and venue position.
input.summary: Add exclusive New York County venue to the New York governing law clause.
